$comment: Written from crates/xenonet-model by cargo test -p xenonet-model. Change the type there, not this file.
title: A message between hosts
description: One message from an agent, actor or the person on one host to an agent or actor on another.

mid.description: The message's id across the network (its envelope's mid)

sender.description: The sender's id on its own host; the receiver qualifies it

strength.description: strong: checked by the window key, or by process checks on macOS; weak: claimed, not checked

auth.description: How the sender's own host checked it

target.description: The recipient's id on the receiving host, unqualified

anyOf.description: The message's id across the network (its envelope's mid)

scope.description: direct, repo or all: how the sender addressed it

hops.description: Messages in its thread so far, across hosts, for the hop limit
